scripts.dev: concurrently --shell="D:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/bash.exe" --kill-others-on-fail -n client,server,validators -c blue,green,yellow "npm run client" "npm run server" "npm run validators"

scripts.vercel-build-server: npm run prisma:deploy && npm run build:server
